description: This file defines the CartViewModel class, which manages cart-related data and interactions for the frontend of an online shopping platform. It interfaces with repositories to fetch and update cart items, coupons, totals, and user email, exposing observable states to the UI layer. It also provides several methods for cart manipulation like adding/removing items, applying/removing coupons, and clearing the cart.

classes.name: CartViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class managing cart data and user interactions in the shopping app.

classes.name: CartRow
classes.description: Sealed class representing rows in a sectioned RecyclerView for the cart UI. Contains header and item subclasses.

methods.name: ensureCartLoaded
methods.description: Ensures the cart data has been fetched at least once for the current user.

methods.name: setActiveEmail
methods.description: Sets or clears the user email identity associated with the cart.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by its ID.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a product in the cart; removes it if quantity <= 0.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a coupon code to the cart, validating it with the backend.

methods.name: addSavedCoupon
methods.description: Adds a coupon code to the list of saved coupons.

methods.name: removeSavedCoupon
methods.description: Removes a coupon code from the saved list.

methods.name: clearSavedCoupons
methods.description: Clears the entire list of saved coupons.

methods.name: isCouponSaved
methods.description: Checks if a coupon code is in the saved list.
